name: @hermit/mobile-preview
description: Dev-only: renders the real apps/mobile screens in a browser with sample data, for screenshots. Not part of the app.

scripts.compress: python3 -c "import glob; from PIL import Image; [Image.open(f).convert('RGB').quantize(colors=256, dither=Image.Dither.NONE).save(f, optimize=True) for f in glob.glob('out/screens/*.png')]"
scripts.polish: node build.mjs && node shoot.mjs && node words.mjs dist out/screens/words.json && node clips.mjs && node polish-gallery.mjs
